title: AGENTS.md: record the ADR-registry rule — a decision lives where the code it governs lives; cloud records are cited as `cloud ADR-NNNN`, never bare; a cloud decision whose mechanism half governs open code gets a local ADR with Provenance (the 0079 shape)
body:
Part of #14496 (maintainer ruling 2026-09-02, 「ok」 to option 2). Filed by the director seat, session `session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk`. `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface and the agent-instruction face ⇒ **skills lane, draft PR, human merge**; Clause ① applies to the dispatch tier per the pm-dispatch skill (agent-instruction file). Clause-②: no.

## The rule to land (one paragraph, in the ADR / governed-territory section — today's anchors are the `docs/adr/`-governed guidance around AGENTS.md line ~275 and the governed-surface definition around line ~291; place it where the ADR-citation reader looks, ⛔ no new section header if an existing one fits)

Verbatim from the ruling on #14496 (translate for the English file, keep the Chinese quote as the provenance line):

> 决策住在它治理的代码所在的仓。划开闭源边界与商业的决策住 cloud,本仓引用一律 `cloud ADR-NNNN`(⛔ 永不裸号);凡 cloud 决策的机制半边治理本仓开源代码的,本仓自有 ADR(自有编号 + `Provenance` 段指回 cloud 记录与日期,商业半边留 cloud),cloud 记录加一行指针;⛔ 不搬文件、不重编号。

English rendering to land: **An ADR lives in the repository whose code it governs.** Decisions that draw the open/closed or commercial boundary live in `objectstack-ai/cloud` and are cited from this repo as `cloud ADR-NNNN` — never as a bare number, which `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` resolves against *this* registry (the two registries number independently, so a bare id silently lands on an unrelated local record: 0071 / 0024 / 0081 today). When a cloud decision's **mechanism half** governs open code in this repo, this repo carries its own ADR — own number, a `## Provenance` section naming the cloud record and its date, the commercial half left in cloud — and the cloud record gains a one-line pointer. Files are never moved between registries and numbers are never reassigned.

## Why here and not only in the gate

The gate already accepts the qualifier structurally (`CROSS_REPO_QUALIFIERS`); what it cannot know is which bare number *meant* the other registry. The rule is what an author reads before writing the citation; the precedent it names (ADR-0079's Provenance section) is what they copy.

## Constraints

- Line budget: net +6 to +10 lines in AGENTS.md; ⛔ no restatement elsewhere (`CLAUDE.md` stays as is).
- ⛔ Do not edit `scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` in this PR (a topic-consistency criterion for the gate was deliberately **not ordered** on #14361).

Refs: #14496 (ruling) · #14361 (the re-pointing pass) · the three mirror-ADR sub-issues of #14496 · ADR-0079.
